messages:
maria: Heads-up — CI is red on master, 3 linux/bazel shards failing after the Python protobuf bump landed yesterday. Failures look like duplicate genrule outputs. Anyone already triaging?

alex: I can repro locally with `bazel build //... --config=ci` on linux. Error is `ERROR: multiple rules generate 'bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/third_party/protos/_virtual_imports/foo/foo.pb.cc'` — log snippet below:

sam: ```
ERROR: /workspace/third_party/protos/BUILD:42:1: in cc_library rule //third_party/protos:foo_cc: output 'third_party/protos/foo.pb.cc' is generated by both genrule //third_party/protos:gen_foo and proto_library //third_party/protos:foo_proto.
```

jen: hmm. That sounds like a BUILD duplication. Could be a stale genrule left after proto_library migration. Any recent changes in third_party/protos? @aloha opened a big reorg last week.

ravi: I can run a quick bisect. Which commit range was last green? ci-bot: last green for linux-bazel was 1744989000.

ci-bot: CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/job/masters/linux-bazel/12345 (failing shards: 2,5,7)

alex: I grepped the tree — there are two rules producing foo.pb.cc: an explicit genrule introduced in 3rd_party/protos/BUILD and the new proto_library rule in the reorg. Looks like a merge conflict where the genrule wasn't removed.

maria: OK, queued a rerun to see if it's flaky while we confirm root cause: `ci rerun --shards=2,5,7` (link: https://ci.internal/retry/12345). If rerun still fails, ravi please bisect.

ravi: Starting `git bisect` now with script `scripts/ci/bisect-failing-targets.sh --target=//third_party/protos:all --build-config=ci`. Will post the commit that introduced duplication.

sam: Quick local workaround for anyone blocked: remove the extra genrule in your local workspace or add `visibility = ["//visibility:private"]` to suppress top-level conflict — but please don't commit that, it's only for local dev.

aloha: I'm checking the reorg PR — yeah, I accidentally left the genrule while migrating some protos to proto_library. Opening a tiny follow-up PR to drop the genrule and update the BUILD to only expose the proto_library outputs.

jen: Nice catch, @aloha. Once the PR is up, can someone trigger a targeted CI on `//third_party/protos:all`? `ci rerun --targets=//third_party/protos:all` should be fast.

maria: @aloha please ping here when the PR is open. If the bisect finds a different root cause, call it out. Otherwise we'll merge the cleanup and watch CI. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Rerun scheduled: https://ci.internal/retry/12345/2 — status: queued.
